verdict.rationale: The evidence only gives a headline claim of 200+ formats with a few examples. It contains no documented read/write format list or input-to-output conversion matrix for checking a pair in advance. One community user even asks where to find the full coder list, and 'convert -list delegate' is cited only in a security context about delegate logic, so it is adjacent rather than a conversion-pair reference.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it
